name: B. L. Kashyap and Sons Limited

facts.business: B. L. Kashyap and Sons Limited is engaged in construction contracts, recognizing revenue using the percentage of completion method.

auditor.name: Not stated in the provided excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: (a) Provident Fund dues pending before Hon'ble High Court of Delhi with ₹15.00 crores held as deposit; (b) Right of Recompense with CDR lenders not yet quantified, provision of ₹35 crores made; (c) Exceptional items of ₹37.82 crores including additional provision of ₹20.00 crores for Right of Recompense and write-off of ₹17.80 crores from contract assets.

key_risks: Revenue recognition on construction contracts involves significant judgement in estimating total contract costs, stage of completion, variations, claims and liquidated damages
Recoverability of contract assets and trade receivables, including balances under dispute and amounts outstanding for extended periods, involves significant management judgement
Measurement of expected credit loss on trade receivables and contract assets
facts.related_party_note: Canara Bank Credit Facility is secured by way of Equitable mortgage of property of M/s Ahuja Kashyap Malts Private Limited; Non-disposal undertaking and encumbered share holding of B. L. Kashyap and Sons Limited in favour of lenders by the Whole Time Directors.
